paragraph: An agent that controls Quantum ESPRESSO's pw.x in words for one H2 molecule: asked to fit the H2 bond, it computes the total energy at the bond lengths the person named, fits the harmonic bond's force constant and rest length to that energy curve with a library skill, and writes both as one hand-over card in its outbox for the HOOMD-blue agent, each value with the conditions pw.x printed. It never carries the card itself: the person starts the bridge that does.

tool_reading.claim: pw.x reads namelists &CONTROL, &SYSTEM and &ELECTRONS and the cards ATOMIC_SPECIES, ATOMIC_POSITIONS and K_POINTS; quantities whose dimensions are not stated are in Rydberg atomic units
loci: INPUT_PW.html, INTRODUCTION: 'All quantities whose dimensions are not explicitly specified are in RYDBERG ATOMIC UNITS'

tool_reading.claim: ecutwfc and ecutrho are the kinetic energy cutoffs in Ry for wavefunctions and for charge density; with ultrasoft pseudopotentials an ecutrho larger than four times ecutwfc is often desirable
celldm(1) is the lattice parameter in bohr; with ibrav 1 the cell is simple cubic
assume_isolated 'martyna-tuckerman' corrects the total energy and the self-consistent potential of a molecule in a 3D supercell
the species mass in ATOMIC_SPECIES is used only for molecular dynamics or damped dynamics, not in an scf run
the pseudopotential H.pbe-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF is ultrasoft, for the PBE functional, and states suggested minimum cutoffs for wavefunctions and charge density

questions_for_the_person.needed_before: the build: the scan's settings are the agent's rows and its tasks' inputs
questions_for_the_person.question: The DFT agent (Quantum ESPRESSO) fits the H2 bond to pw.x energies at several bond lengths, and its scientific task needs one set of run settings that only you can choose. My recommendation: cutoffs 46 Ry and 221 Ry (the minimums the pseudopotential file suggests, the maker's statement); five bond lengths 1.30, 1.35, 1.40, 1.45 and 1.50 bohr (spaced around NIST's measured 0.74144 Å, which is 1.4011 bohr by unit_convert@v1; the spacing is my inference, not from a source); a cubic box of 12 bohr side and a convergence threshold of 1e-8 Ry (both my inference; the adapter's trial ran there, and no convergence study stands behind them). Which settings should the agent use?
questions_for_the_person.how: one of two buttons, the recommendation marked

answer.gloss: the button this seat wrote: cutoffs 46/221 Ry, bond lengths 1.30-1.50 bohr in steps of 0.05, box 12 bohr, conv_thr 1e-8 Ry, the box and the threshold marked as having no convergence study

contract.name: fetch_pseudopotential
contract.description: fetch the hydrogen pseudopotential the scans use, PSLibrary's H.pbe-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF, anonymously and read-only from pseudopotentials.quantum-espresso.org into runs/inputs/pseudo, and keep it only when its bytes are the ones the builder read; a file already there with those bytes is not fetched again

file.description: the pseudopotential's path, relative to this directory

sha256.description: its content hash, the one the builder read

fetched.description: false where the file was there already with those bytes

safety_gate.place: src/gate.py, consulted by src/run_tool.py before the call

error_contracts.message: the pseudopotential could not be read from its host

remediation.action: try again later; a network problem may pass on a retry

error_contracts.message: the file read is not the bytes the builder read

remediation.action: nothing was kept; a person says whether the source changed

error_contracts.message: a pseudopotential is there with other bytes

remediation.action: a person removes it or names why it differs; this agent writes no file over it

contract.name: scan_h2_bond
contract.description: run one self-consistent pw.x calculation of one H2 molecule at each bond length named, in a cubic box at the gamma point with the Martyna-Tuckerman correction, each in its own folder of a new scan folder under runs/scan, and return the energy curve: each pair a bond length as given and the total energy pw.x printed for it, with the conditions pw.x printed, which must be the same for every point; a point that did not converge or did not end with JOB DONE ends the scan with an error

bond_lengths.description: the bond lengths to compute, each once

box_side.description: the side of the cubic box, the first of the celldm constants

ecutwfc.description: the kinetic energy cutoff for wavefunctions

ecutrho.description: the kinetic energy cutoff for charge density and potential

conv_thr.description: the convergence threshold of the self-consistent loop

n_processes.description: how many MPI processes each pw.x runs on, a positive count, through the environment's mpirun; null starts pw.x directly, without mpirun

budget_s.description: the running time each pw.x may take before the call gives up on it, counted while it runs and not while it is paused; no limit when null

pseudo_dir.description: the folder that holds the pseudopotential

run_dir.description: the scan folder, relative to this directory

energy_curve.description: pairs of a bond length in bohr, as given, and the total energy pw.x printed for it, in Ry

printed_conditions.description: what pw.x printed of the conditions, the same for every point: the cutoffs, the lattice parameter, the threshold, the processes, the exchange-correlation functional, the pseudopotential file, the species mass it used and the isolated-system correction

points.description: each point's bond length, folder, total energy, iterations and convergence as pw.x printed them

safety_gate.place: src/gate.py, consulted by src/run_tool.py before the call

error_contracts.message: the scan's input is not one the contract takes, or a bond length is named twice or is not shorter than the box

remediation.action: give each bond length once, each shorter than the box side, and every input the contract requires

error_contracts.message: this agent's environment is not made

remediation.action: call install_environment first, then this call again

error_contracts.message: the pseudopotential is not in its folder

remediation.action: call fetch_pseudopotential first, then this call again

error_contracts.message: processes asked for and no mpirun in this agent's environment

remediation.action: call with n_processes null, or remake the environment

error_contracts.message: a pw.x run of the scan failed, did not converge or did not end with JOB DONE

remediation.action: read pw.out in the run folder the error names; no energy of the scan is used

error_contracts.message: pw.x printed different conditions for the points of one scan

remediation.action: read result.json in the scan folder; no energy curve is handed on from runs under different conditions

error_contracts.message: the call gave up on a pw.x run after its budget of running time and stopped it

remediation.action: call again with a larger budget_s, or none

error_contracts.message: a pw.x run was stopped from outside

remediation.action: call again with the same input to start the scan over
